complexity.notes: The try/except-as-control-flow is unidiomatic: iterating range(len(nums)-1) and returning nums[0] after the loop expresses the same logic without a bare except. The scaling note's rotated-by-one input is exactly this algorithm's worst case, so it benchmarks linear while a binary search would be O(log n).
complexity.summary: Linear scan for the single index where nums[i] > nums[i+1], i.e., the rotation point; the minimum is nums[i+1]. If the scan reaches the last index (array fully sorted), an IndexError is caught and nums[0] is returned.
